Track the remaining Guitar Pro import, public model, and GP8 export differences against pinned AlphaTab 1.8.4.

The audit contains 107 capabilities (101 in scope). These 77 work items cover all 55 currently incomplete capability rows, including separately scoped diagnostic and audit blockers.
Implementation tickets have bounded observable requirements. Investigation tickets first classify unresolved behavior and record follow-up defects or explicit limits.

[Database and agent workflow](https://github.com/CaliLuke/go-guitar-pro/blob/main/conformance/capabilities/README.md) · [Inventory](https://github.com/CaliLuke/go-guitar-pro/blob/main/conformance/capabilities/CAPABILITIES.md) · [Backlog](https://github.com/CaliLuke/go-guitar-pro/blob/main/conformance/capabilities/BACKLOG.md)

Run `python3 conformance/capabilities/manage.py ready` after checkout. Honor hard dependencies and coordinate shared files. Check `external_input_blockers` for fixture acquisition tasks; missing external inputs are excluded from the ready queue. Each ticket contains its evidence and acceptance checklist. Do not close from a passing self-round-trip or coverage count.

Ordinary repeat count semantics already have #38. Simile support landed in commit 339113c under #39 and passed the audit recheck. Neither is duplicated here; navigation directions remain a separate task.

<!-- go-guitar-pro-capability-work:automation-detail -->

Retain interpolation, text and visibility on authored tempo/sound events while separating sync-point occurrence fields.

**Type:** implementation. **Priority:** P1. **Capability:** `automation-detail`.
**Formats:** gp3, gp4, gp5, gp6, gp7, gp8. **Stages to assess:** import, model, export.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Test linear and step events with the same non-default value and distinct text/visibility at one position.
- [ ] Keep event order and public edit authority explicit; validate positions and finite values.
- [ ] GP8/AlphaTab retains each representable detail; source-only details have precise diagnostics rather than broad normalization.

Any public API change must expose the authored value with a documented edit/reconciliation contract. Add a non-default public API regression and independent pinned-consumer export evidence. Preserve compatibility or explicitly document the change.

## Scope boundaries

- SyncPointData.barOccurence is a sync-point field, not a generic Automation field.
- Bank events are handled by midi-bank.

## Reproduction and evidence

Test linear and step events with the same non-default value and distinct text/visibility at one position.

This starts from a source review. Construct a valid non-default fixture that exercises the acceptance criteria; the lack of a saved probe is not evidence of support.

- AlphaTab [SyncPointData.barOccurence](https://github.com/CoderLine/alphaTab/blob/022a45c8e42370f9e12e68949d11eada370da83d/packages/alphatab/src/model/Automation.ts#L69)
- AlphaTab [Automation.isLinear](https://github.com/CoderLine/alphaTab/blob/022a45c8e42370f9e12e68949d11eada370da83d/packages/alphatab/src/model/Automation.ts#L88)
- AlphaTab [Automation.type](https://github.com/CoderLine/alphaTab/blob/022a45c8e42370f9e12e68949d11eada370da83d/packages/alphatab/src/model/Automation.ts#L93)
- AlphaTab [Automation.ratioPosition](https://github.com/CoderLine/alphaTab/blob/022a45c8e42370f9e12e68949d11eada370da83d/packages/alphatab/src/model/Automation.ts#L108)
- Repository [gpif_audit.go](https://github.com/CaliLuke/go-guitar-pro/blob/30436b08bf7f342ceda0d97c5ddd2c085db1b4f1/gpif_audit.go)
- Repository [gpif_automations.go](https://github.com/CaliLuke/go-guitar-pro/blob/30436b08bf7f342ceda0d97c5ddd2c085db1b4f1/gpif_automations.go)

Oracle: AlphaTab 1.8.4, revision `022a45c8e42370f9e12e68949d11eada370da83d`. Audit baseline: `30436b08bf7f342ceda0d97c5ddd2c085db1b4f1`.

## Dependencies and coordination

No hard prerequisite.

Before claiming, refresh issue state and check `ready_work` and `work_conflicts`. Mark the work item `in_progress` with an owner. Source pointers are starting points; shared-file overlap is advisory and not an exhaustive conflict map.

## Verification and inventory update

- Follow `AGENTS.md`, `docs/semantic-model.md`, and `conformance/README.md` for semantic changes. Add domain-named tests and update `conformance/feature-ledger.json`.
- Run `./conformance/check.sh` and `prek run --all-files` for semantic changes. Rerun the capability probe before claiming a gap is resolved.
- Update the [canonical work item](https://github.com/CaliLuke/go-guitar-pro/blob/main/conformance/capabilities/work-items/automation-detail.json) with the resolution, verified commit, command results, and evidence. Update the scoped catalog assessment separately; tests passing or issue closure never promote it automatically.
- Run `python3 conformance/capabilities/manage.py refresh` and commit the JSON, database, and generated reports together.
- Review every acceptance criterion against the exact final commit and completed prerequisites before closing. Record residual limits and open follow-up issues.

<!-- go-guitar-pro-capability-work:bends -->

Preserve GPIF bend offsets that the current integer 0..12 public scale rounds away, while keeping an explicit edit contract for existing callers.

**Type:** implementation. **Priority:** P1. **Capability:** `bends`.
**Formats:** gp3, gp4, gp5, gp6, gp7, gp8. **Stages to assess:** import, model, export.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A valid 35% GPIF offset remains 35% after public import, edit and GP8 export; include a fractional percentage such as 35.5 because pinned AlphaTab also retains fractional offsets on its 0..60 scale.
- [ ] Preserve endpoints and two distinct middle offsets in source control-role order, with representable quarter-tone values; compare exact wire values and independent consumer offsets.
- [ ] Define one authority between any exact offset representation and the existing Position field. Existing binary positions and post-parse caller edits must have documented, tested conversions without silent rounding.
- [ ] Reject non-finite and out-of-range authored offsets before narrowing; retain precise reports for genuinely unsupported shapes and metadata. Update field, enum, wire and source-dispatch obligations for the changed contract.

Any public API change must expose the authored value with a documented edit/reconciliation contract. Add a non-default public API regression and independent pinned-consumer export evidence. Preserve compatibility or explicitly document the change.

## Scope boundaries

- No invented BendStyle or per-point vibrato wire fields. More than four controls, incompatible middle values, and non-quarter-tone heights remain separate target/oracle limits.
- Do not claim an integer 0..60 scale is exact for every GPIF float. Whammy integration is #72; nonmonotonic control-role validation is #62.

## Reproduction and evidence

A valid 35% GPIF offset remains 35% after public import, edit and GP8 export; include a fractional percentage such as 35.5 because pinned AlphaTab also retains fractional offsets on its 0..60 scale. See the linked investigation decision and review receipt for the confirmed baseline.

Use the named fixtures and non-default cases above. The linked investigation and review distinguish reproduced failures from source-backed implementation gaps.

- AlphaTab [BendPoint.MaxPosition](https://github.com/CoderLine/alphaTab/blob/022a45c8e42370f9e12e68949d11eada370da83d/packages/alphatab/src/model/BendPoint.ts#L10)
- AlphaTab [BendPoint.MaxValue](https://github.com/CoderLine/alphaTab/blob/022a45c8e42370f9e12e68949d11eada370da83d/packages/alphatab/src/model/BendPoint.ts#L11)
- AlphaTab [BendPoint.offset](https://github.com/CoderLine/alphaTab/blob/022a45c8e42370f9e12e68949d11eada370da83d/packages/alphatab/src/model/BendPoint.ts#L16)
